summary: A trade license is required for any commercial establishment in Chandigarh. The process takes 7–15 working days and involves online registration, document preparation, application submission, and certificate issuance.

steps.title: Register on the e-Sewa portal
steps.description: Create an account on the Municipal Corporation Chandigarh online services portal using a valid mobile number and email address. Registration is free and immediate.

steps.title: Prepare identity and ownership documents
steps.description: Collect proof of identity (Aadhaar/PAN), proof of address, and ownership or rent agreement documents for the premises.

steps.title: Fill the online application form
steps.description: Log in to the portal, select the Trade License service, and complete the application form with premises details, applicant details, and category of request.

steps.title: Upload documents
steps.description: Upload scanned copies of all required documents in PDF or JPG format, each under 2 MB, as listed on the application form.

steps.title: Pay the applicable fee online
steps.description: Pay the fee via net banking, UPI, debit or credit card. Fees vary by category of establishment; the portal shows the exact amount before payment.

steps.title: Track application status
steps.description: Use the application reference number to track status on the portal. Status updates are also sent by SMS to the registered mobile number.

steps.title: Receive approval certificate
steps.description: Once approved, the certificate is issued digitally and can be downloaded from the portal. Physical collection is available if preferred.

warnings: Fees are subject to revision. Verify current amounts on the official portal.
